lines.en: Last Saturday was a very hot day.
lines.zh: 上个星期六天气特别热。

lines.en: My aircon was not working.
I called the aircon uncle.
lines.zh: 我给空调师傅打了电话。

lines.en: He can come on Monday.
I went to the hawker centre with my husband.
lines.zh: 我和老公去了 hawker centre。

lines.en: My coffee was cold, and the spoon was dirty.
lines.zh: 我的咖啡是凉的，勺子也是脏的。

lines.en: "Excuse me, my coffee is cold."
The uncle was very nice.
lines.zh: 卖咖啡的 uncle 人很好。

lines.en: "Sorry about that! Let me make a new one."
lines.zh: "真不好意思！我给你重新做一杯。"

lines.en: After that, we went home.
The lift was broken. We took the stairs.
lines.zh: 电梯坏了，我们走了楼梯。

lines.en: It was a long day!

dialogue.title: 教室太热了
dialogue.setting: 下午，家长 Mrs Wong 来接孩子，在前台说教室里太热。

lines.speaker: Mrs Wong
lines.en: Hi, the classroom is very hot today.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I'm sorry about that.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The aircon is not working.

lines.speaker: Mrs Wong
lines.en: My child is tired and hot.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I understand. Let me check for you.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The aircon uncle will come tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 空调师傅明天早上会来。

lines.speaker: Mrs Wong
lines.en: Can you open the window?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, and let me turn on the fan.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Let me get you some water.

lines.speaker: Mrs Wong
lines.en: Thank you. Please call me after class.
lines.zh: 谢谢。下课后请给我打个电话。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: No problem. I'll tell the teacher.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you for telling us. It won't happen again.
lines.zh: 谢谢您告诉我们。不会再这样了。
